memes: "Saxophone Gets Louder" — clips escalate from calm to total disaster synced to a progressively unhinged sax track; used for anything that spirals fast
KitKat Heist — riffing on the real European theft of 400,000 KitKat bars in transit; brands and creators pitch elaborate Ocean's Eleven-style backstories for who pulled it off
"Kinda chic to…" — Twitter/X format where someone describes something broke, depressing, or chaotic as aspirational luxury (e.g. "kinda chic to eat cereal at 2 a.m. alone")
Ancestor Photo Prank — creators send parents a vintage-filtered celebrity photo (often Kim Kardashian) claiming it's a real 1800s great-great-grandparent; reaction videos flood TikTok
GTA 6 countdown memes — with the November 19 release locked in, fans post increasingly unhinged "days remaining" edits and mock-serious "preparation guides"
"Right Round Hangover" — staged morning-after party-wreckage scenes around someone asleep, perfectly timed to Flo Rida's "Right Round"; used to describe any situation that got out of hand
